description:
I’m vedant, an engineering admission and career counsellor who helps students make informed and confident choices.
I guide students through college and branch selection across Maharashtra, based on ranks, preferences, and future plans.
My work includes detailed cutoff analysis, CAP round guidance, and accurate option filling.
I believe in honest counselling, realistic guidance, and clarity at every step.
My aim is to support students in taking the right academic decision without confusion or pressure.
